svg.title: LinkedIn job search automation roadmap — three phases
svg.desc: Three-phase plan evolving from Claude Pro quick win to Claude Code scaffold to fully agnostic control plane
svg.text: Tool: Claude Pro + Projects. Zero code. Lean on the ecosystem.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What goes in my master profile document for job search?')
sendPrompt('How do I use Claude to score and filter LinkedIn job postings?')
sendPrompt('How do I tailor a resume and cover letter per job using Claude?')
sendPrompt('What does a simple job tracker in markdown look like?')
g.text: Output: markdown job tracker in git — your first owned memory artifact

svg.text: Tool: Claude Code + git. First real automation. Still on Anthropic stack.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I build a LinkedIn job scraper with Claude Code?')
sendPrompt('How do I build an AI job scoring script in Claude Code?')
sendPrompt('How do I auto-generate tailored resumes with Claude Code?')
sendPrompt('How do I build a git-based application tracker?')
sendPrompt('What does the CLAUDE.md instruction file look like for job search?')
g.text: Output: CLAUDE.md + scripts in git — portable instruction set emerges

svg.text: Tool: LiteLLM + your own scheduler + mobile approval. You own everything.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I set up LiteLLM as my model router?')
sendPrompt('How do I build a mobile approval flow for job applications?')
sendPrompt('How do I set up a self-hosted scheduler for job search automation?')
sendPrompt('What does the fully agnostic personal OS look like for job search?')
g.text: Output: fully owned OS — no vendor lock-in, mobile-driven, cloud-executable
